title: Puzzle 3D Suggestion Collision Fill Parity
description: Verify that the migrated puzzle/3d (now wired through puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs Puzzle3dPlayApp on the DocumentApp/CQRS pattern) still has full parity with the premigration React app's suggestion system: collision-checked brush candidates for suggested objects, and a background worker-equivalent that incrementally checks options for collisions during fill. Confirm build/tests pass and that collision detection (solid_overlap_volume/bodies_intersect), candidate ranking/suggestion (brush_compatible_candidates, brush_candidate_rank, weighted suggestion), and greedy weighted fill (FillBuilder / apply_puzzle3d_fill_count) are all correctly wired into Puzzle3dPlayApp's action handlers (openVortexSuggestions, acceptSuggestion, cycleBrushCandidate, setFillCount, suggestionsTick, fillBuildTick). Fix any gaps found.
summary:
Verified the premigration puzzle/3d suggestion system (parry3d collision detection, weighted candidate ranking/suggestion, greedy weighted fill, incremental worker-style precompute) is fully present with parity in the migrated Puzzle3dPlayApp (puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs), which now runs on the DocumentApp/CQRS pattern instead of a browser Worker: openVortexSuggestions/acceptSuggestion/cycleBrushCandidate/setFillCount/suggestionsTick/fillBuildTick all correctly drive Puzzle3dPrecomputeSession (from puzzle_3d) each doing bounded incremental collision-checked precompute steps, matching the old worker's self-scheduling idle loop. cargo build -p puzzle-plugin -p puzzle_3d is clean; cargo test -p puzzle-plugin -p puzzle_3d passes 39/39 (all d3 suggestion/collision/fill tests green: open_vortex_suggestions_opens_the_suggestion_popup, accept_suggestion_appends_an_object_and_closes_the_menu, fill_build_tick_auto_starts_fill_when_active_and_done, fill_count_control_shows_building_progress_while_precompute_incomplete, context_menu_at_selects_vortex_and_prepends_suggest_objects, etc).

While verifying, found and fixed two real bugs surfaced by puzzle_3d's own test suite:
1. Puzzle3dOp::UpsertItem had no way to restore an item's original array position on undo/backwards, so undoing a RemoveItem (or replaying inverses) silently reordered collections — added an `index: Option<usize>` field used only when inserting a fresh item (id not already present), populated correctly in `backwards()` via a new `puzzle3d_item_index` helper. Fixes puzzle3d_delta_ops_round_trip_and_stay_granular.
2. puzzle/3d/manifest/default.manifest.json declared edge kind id `attraction.link` while every example fixture (concrete-forest.3d.json, nakagin-capsule-tower.3d.json, and the 5d/2d manifests that cross-reference it) actually use `puzzle3d.attraction.link` — fixed the manifest to the id actually in use and regenerated via `bun nx run @semio-tech/graph-manifest:generate`. Fixes concrete_forest_kind_catalog_matches_puzzle3d_default_manifest.

Also discovered, while fixing #2, that .gitignore's leftover PyInstaller boilerplate (`MANIFEST` / `*.manifest`) was case-insensitively matching every directory literally named `manifest` anywhere in the repo (core.ignorecase=true on this machine), silently untracking every domain's hand-authored *.manifest.json source file including this one. Fixed .gitignore (scoped `MANIFEST` to `/MANIFEST` root-only, dropped `*.manifest`; left the unrelated `generated` rule alone since mathematical/graph/manifest/generated/ is legitimate codegen output). Flagged the repo-wide fallout (other domains' now-newly-trackable manifest.json files) as a separate follow-up task rather than expanding this ticket's scope.
